csv_project_name: AE for Fair Bluff Downtown Development Center
csv_scope_of_work: The Town of Fair Bluff has received a $188,888 Rural Business Cooperative Service, US Department of Agriculture, Rural Business Development Grant (RBDG) to assist in the design and renovation of Suite 100, Town of Fair Bluff Downtown Development Center.The Town of Fair Bluff is seeking to enter into a single turn-key professional contract that will include: a) Schematic design, b) Design development, c) Construction document design and permitting, d) Construction document procurement/bidding, e) Construction inspection/observation, and f) Construction administration that includes construction bid/contract documents containing RBDG requirements.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Inspection Services, Structural Engineering
